files.why: O-017: T-008's bad-value table gains four rows: an empty name, a name with a path separator, error 18 (ERROR_NO_MORE_FILES) and a non-numeric error. Each has its own refusal regex. The case's header comment now lists them.

obligations.how: Added the four rows O-017 names to T-008's `$bad` table. Each regex matches the exact log line and pins the reason: `'|2|995'` must log ArgumentException "'' is not one folder's name (Parameter 'folderName')". `'a\b|2|995'` must log ArgumentException "'a\b' is not one folder's name (Parameter 'folderName')". `'folder1|2|18'` must log ArgumentOutOfRangeException "...(Parameter 'win32Error') Actual value was 18.", which tells it apart from the error-0 refusal. `'folder1|2|x'` must log FormatException "the error 'x' is not a whole number". I ran `WindowCases.ps1 -Case T-008`. All eight values were refused, and each launch ended with 0xE0434352 within 30 s, wrote no report, and left one hook line matching its regex. No Core bug turned up, so src/ is unchanged.

tests.note: It rebuilt the hook, and the published exe was already current. It ran eight launches: the original four plus `folder1|2|x`, `folder1|2|18`, `|2|995` and `a\b|2|995`. Each ended with exit -532462766 (0xE0434352), wrote no report, and left exactly one hook line, e.g. "fail-listing refused reason=ArgumentOutOfRangeException: an error that fails a listing, not 0 or ERROR_NO_MORE_FILES (Parameter 'win32Error') Actual value was 18." Result: PASSED: T-008, exit 0.

48 cases passed, exit 0: C-001 to C-014, O-016, L-001 to L-003, B-001 to B-008, V-001, P-001, T-001 to T-004, T-006, T-007, T-008, K-001 to K-003, R-001 and S-001 to S-009. T-005 and M-001 are not in the All set, and N-001 to N-004 need -IncludeNetwork; the same set ran in attempt 1. The suite runs the Release single-file published exe from artifacts/publish through its real entry point, both under the hook and without it. That was the run-it-as-shipped check for this attempt.
